pr_title: log: create crdb-v2 log entry parser and integrate it into debug merge-logs
pr_body:
Fixes [#65504](https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/65504).

The crdb-v2 log file format is not recognized by some tools like debug merge-logs.
This is makes it difficult/impossible to merge log files properly.
This patch creates a new parser and integrates it into debug merge-logs.

Release note (cli change): the tool debug merge-logs is now able to recognize 
crdb-v2 formatted log files.

@knz 
When using `debug merge-logs`, the log format can be specified using the format flag - a string variable. This variable is used in the `NewEntryDecoder` and `Decode` functions. 

We want to make it easier to integrate new parsers going forward. To facilitate this, I added a `format` attribute to the `EntryDecoder` struct. How the decoder is constructed is based on the format. If a format is not specified, the format information is retrieved from the log (panics if the log format information does not exist). The `Decode` function makes a call to the appropriate decode function based on format e.g. returns `DecodeV2` if the log format is crdb-v2. This code, in addition to some other code not specific to a particular format, has been moved from `format_crdb_v1.go` and `format_crdb_v2.go` to `formats.go`. 

Integrating a new parser in tools going forward should be as simple as implementing the new parser and then updating the mapping of format to parser in `formats.go`.

I updated calls to functions that depend on parsing like `log.FetchEntriesFromFiles`, which now takes log format as an argument. Passing the empty string signals that the log format should be retrieved from the log.

issue_context.title: log: implement a crdb-v2 log entry parser and use it in `debug merge-logs`
issue_context.body:
Since v21.1 the log files use a new file format called `crdb-v2`.

- Previously (in `crdb-v1`) entries were not delimited properly, so the entry parser was using heuristics to find the entry boundary and had a maximum size of 64K
- In the new format, entries can be split across multiple lines, with a continuation delimiter. There is no maximum size.

However, the new format is not recognized by the tool `debug merge-log` which we routinely use in tech support. This makes it difficult/impossible to merge log files properly.

We want to create an entry parser and integrate it into `debug merge-log`. The new parser should be combined with the following new functionality in `debug merge-log`:

- load multi-line entries as a single entry in memory for the purpose of merging log files together.
- convert from one format to another. In particular we want to offer the ability to emit v2 entries in the `crdb-v1` format for compatibility with previous-version tools

The new parser should exist alongside the v1 parser (i.e. it is an addition, not a replacement)

At this point, the work described in this issue is not an invitation to update the `GetLogs` HTTP API to use the new parser. We will need to discuss later (in a separate issue) what we want to do with that API; it's possible we will need to change it entirely so it remains out of scope here..

Related issues: #49509  #32956

review_comments: Now that we're buffering a whole file in RAM (something I was actively trying to avoid when I wrote this), we can have this just return `([]byte, error)`.
Doesn't need to be in this PR but how would you feel about making Format into a type. It can have methods like FormatEntry and NewDecoder.
Sounds like a good idea to me!
